_doc: Pairwise interactions between attacker-side and defender-side capability tags. When a card in the user's deck carries an attacker tag and a card in the opposing archetype carries the matching defender tag, the engine flags this as a detected tech-counter matchup. matchup_value is a tentative WR-bonus heuristic (percentage points) for that specific opponent, capped per opponent by the engine.

interactions.narrative_en: {attacker_name} bypasses {defender_name}'s {defender_ability} — effect-immune damage ignores Sturdy-style KO prevention.
interactions.narrative_de: {attacker_name} ignoriert {defender_name}s {defender_ability} — effekt-immuner Schaden umgeht Sturdy-artigen KO-Schutz.

interactions.narrative_en: {attacker_name} attacks through {defender_name}'s ex-immunity — effects on the defending Pokemon do not apply to this attack's damage.
interactions.narrative_de: {attacker_name} schlägt durch {defender_name}s ex-Immunität — Effekte auf dem verteidigenden Pokemon werden für diesen Angriff ignoriert.

interactions.narrative_en: {attacker_name} ignores {defender_name}'s damage-reduction ability — full damage lands.
{defender_name} prevents {attacker_name}'s bench-snipe damage — the bench-pressure plan is shut off.
interactions.narrative_de: {defender_name} blockt den Bench-Snipe von {attacker_name} — der Bench-Druckplan wird ausgehebelt.

interactions.narrative_en: {attacker_name}'s damage hits cleanly but {defender_name} still survives the first hit via {defender_ability}.
interactions.narrative_de: {attacker_name}-Schaden trifft sauber, aber {defender_name} überlebt den ersten Treffer durch {defender_ability}.
